name: maybe_Ui_MapIcon_AddIfFlagSetA
signature: void maybe_Ui_MapIcon_AddIfFlagSetA(void* self, int flagId, int slot)
summary: Places up to three icon panes: tests a 0..3 category flag via 0x0066B088 and either hides the pane at self+slot*4+0x7C or copies the next stack entry's position into it and bumps the count at +0x88.
evidence: Body matches the doc: flag test, pane hide/show at +0x7C, position copy from +0x70 entries, count at +0x88; no callers, so the icon class is unknown.

name: maybe_Ui_MapIcon_AddIfFlagSetB
signature: void maybe_Ui_MapIcon_AddIfFlagSetB(void* self, int flagId, int slot)
summary: Byte-identical twin of 0x003D20E8: same three-icon placement with flag test, pane hide/show and count increment.
evidence: Same body as 0x003D20E8 (template copy); no callers, so which icon class this instance serves is unknown.

name: maybe_Ui_ChildTransform_CreateRowChildren
summary: Creates up to 32 numbered child panes from the ASCII digit template, storing them after the u16 id pair at self+0xB64 and hiding those whose bit is clear in the mask from 0x0066B64C.
evidence: Digit-increment loop with 0x20 cap, layout factory vtable+0x2C, mask test via 0x0066B64C; no callers to pin the row meaning.

name: maybe_Battle_Action_TestFlag80OrMemberHandFlag
signature: u8 maybe_Battle_Action_TestFlag80OrMemberHandFlag(void* unit, int hand, u8* action)
summary: Battle action predicate: checks unit+0x10 and action+0x10, tests bit 0x80 of the spell record +0x2E8 (or skill +0xFF when action[0]==0xFF), else falls back to the acting member's per-hand byte +0xDED/+0xDEE.
evidence: Body matches doc: spell/skill record lookups, 0x80 bit test, member hand bytes via 0x0035EB98; callers are battle target-selection and UI refresh, so the exact predicate meaning stays uncertain.

name: maybe_Ui_MonsterBook_BuildDetailPane
summary: Builds the monster-book detail for one monster: resolves the monster record, matches name-message ids, copies book message text, selects the 2D sprite and animates panes.
evidence: Doc lists monster-record, book-counter, message-text and sprite callees; decompiled body is truncated by a mis-marked noreturn wcslen call, so the name rests on the callee set only.

name: maybe_Casino_SetSpinRateConstant
summary: Stores the float constant 600.0f into the caller's slot and mirrors it to work+0x2DEE0; called by the casino slot speed step.
evidence: Body writes 0x44160000 (600.0f) to *out and to work+0x2DEE0; only caller is maybe_Casino_Slot_UpdateSpeed, so the casino context is plausible but the exact meaning is a guess.

name: maybe_Field_SceneNode_FlushPositions
summary: Walks the node's record list and copies each matching record's position (f_9C/f_A0/f_A4) into the per-object table from 0x00192F78, then releases the lists and container at f_3C4.
evidence: Body matches doc: position copy into table indexed by f_318 with f_268/f_3AA/f_3AB matching, then list/container teardown; no callers to confirm the subsystem.

name: maybe_Work_GetU16FromTable2725C
summary: Pure indexed getter returning the u16 at work + index*2 + 0x2725C from the array just before the display block.
evidence: Single ldrh with no bounds check; no callers name the array, so the generic table wording is kept.

name: Ui_ListRow_IsAvailable
summary: Tests the per-row availability byte for the row id stored at self+row+0x78 via the save array at bag+0x5762 and returns the complement, so callers can skip unavailable rows.
evidence: Calls 0x0066B3F8 with bag+0x24A98 and the row id byte; returns result^1; sole caller Ui_SakusenWindow_UpdateCounter uses it to skip rows.

name: maybe_Ui_UmaWindow_SelectPage
summary: Window vtable slot that clears a row flag and walks the entry table against a work byte array, but the body is too damaged (dead-code warnings, global init branch) to pin down page switching versus row reset.
evidence: No callers; callees include Ui_ReleaseOwnedObjects, Field_Npc_GetDefaultFaceIfUnset, Game_GetWork and a no-op stub; only vtable neighbourhood supports the guess.

name: maybe_Work_TestQuestStateInSet
summary: No dossier or decompiled body available, so the existing quest-state test name cannot be verified or improved.
evidence: No readable file and no dossier; name retained as-is.

name: Work_FillDisplayParams
summary: Copies the global display block fields (work+0x27224..0x27254, header u16 at +0x27C5C, u32 at +0x27C60) into the caller's struct and tags out+0x40 with 0xFF.
evidence: Body reads only work+0x27218 display block fields into out; callers ActorGetRegionBookID and Ui_MapWindow_RefreshEntry consume the struct.

name: maybe_Ui_ListRow_GetRowClass
signature: u8 maybe_Ui_ListRow_GetRowClass(void* self, u32 rowIndex, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Shared row query used by 225 call sites: returns 0xFF when the row index is out of range or the list model (self+0x24C) is missing, 0x15 when either global display-mode byte (work+0x27508/+0x27509) is set, otherwise the row's own byte at +0xB (rows 0xC bytes under model+0x58).
evidence: Body is damaged: the range test uses in_ZR/in_CY flag registers and the row-count compare is garbled (arg3 overwritten with model->f_60), so the exact bounds logic cannot be trusted from the C. What is solid: 225 callers (Battle_SelectAiActions, Ui_CmdQueue_ProcessSlots, Battle_BackupUnitActions) all consume the result as a row state/class, the body reads model+0x60 count and model+0x58+0x24 row base with 0xC stride, and returns 0xFF/0x15 sentinels plus row byte +0xB. No disassembly was cited to repair the flag-register damage, so keep maybe_ and confidence <= 0.3.

name: maybe_Ui_BagList_GetRowState
summary: Maps the per-id byte at work+0x2A4E6+row->f_298 to 0 for values 1/4 and 3 otherwise; the index has no range check and lands in the quest-state array, so the bag-row reading is unproven.
evidence: Only caller is maybe_Ui_Overlay_GetCursorRowState's bag branch; index row->f_298 unchecked against the 0x138-entry quest-state table.

name: maybe_Ui_List_CountSelectableRows
summary: Counts ids in [self+0xB0, self+0xB4) whose 90-bit save flag is clear and whose per-id byte at bag+0x3165 is below 10; the meaning of the flag/byte pair is unknown.
evidence: Callees 0x0066B534 (90-bit mask test at bag+0x89A8) and 0x0066AF08 (bag[id+0x3165], 0xFF for id 0xFF); single unnamed caller.

name: Party_GetInventoryCountByIndex
summary: Returns the occupied inventory-slot count (0..24) for the party member at index self+0x50, or 0 when the index is 0x1F or higher.
evidence: Guard self->f_50 < 0x1F matches 31-member roster; calls 0x0035EB98 to get the member then 0x00629150 which counts non-0xFFFF u16 ids at member+0xEC.

name: maybe_Work_FindFirstFreeSlot
summary: Scans the 90-entry u16 table at bag+0x27C4 for the first 0xFFFF terminator and returns its index; used by UI windows to find a free slot in that table.
evidence: Body only wraps Game_GetWork and calls 0x0066B4F4 on bag+0x24A98; callers are SakusenWindow UI functions, but the table's owner is still unknown, so the generic name stays.

name: maybe_Work_GetIdValueIfAtLeast
signature: u8 maybe_Work_GetIdValueIfAtLeast(u32 arg1, u8* query, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Conditional getter over per-id 0x14-byte records at bag+0x2D2D: returns query[2] when record[id].byte0 >= query[1], else 0.
evidence: Body calls 0x0066B17C(bag, query[0]) and compares query[1] against the returned byte; no callers and the record table's owner is unknown, so the generic name stays.
